title: Follow the Money
coreMove: Read a field by the weight of its outliers instead of the comfort of its averages.
sourcePressure: The chapter introduces venture and power-law logic: a small number of outcomes dominate the economics, so averaging can hide what matters most. The frozen source for this chapter contains no chapter-specific named anecdote beyond author/editor metadata, so examples should use fictional protagonists and stay anchored to verified terms.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Using power-law language as an excuse for reckless extreme bets.
